/// IDP league config (1:1 with League when leagueVariant is idp / IDP / DYNASTY_IDP). NFL only.
/// Position mode: standard (DL/LB/DB), advanced (DE/DT/LB/CB/S), hybrid (grouped + split).
/// Roster preset: beginner | standard | advanced | custom (then use slotOverrides).
/// Scoring preset: balanced | tackle_heavy | big_play_heavy.
model IdpLeagueConfig {
  id                String                      @id @default(uuid())
  leagueId          String                      @unique @db.VarChar(64)
  /// standard = DL/LB/DB only; advanced = DE/DT/LB/CB/S only; hybrid = both grouped and split slots
  positionMode      String                      @default("standard") @db.VarChar(24)
  /// beginner | standard | advanced | custom (custom uses slotOverrides)
  rosterPreset      String                      @default("standard") @db.VarChar(24)
  /// Custom slot counts when rosterPreset = custom. JSON: { DL?: number, LB?: number, DB?: number, IDP_FLEX?: number, DE?: number, DT?: number, CB?: number, S?: number }
  slotOverrides     Json?
  /// balanced | tackle_heavy | big_play_heavy
  scoringPreset     String                      @default("balanced") @db.VarChar(24)
  /// Per-league scoring overrides. JSON: { idp_solo_tackle?: number, idp_sack?: number, ... }. Merged with preset; overrides take precedence.
  scoringOverrides  Json?
  bestBallEnabled   Boolean                     @default(false)
  /// snake | linear | auction
  draftType         String                      @default("snake") @db.VarChar(16)
  benchSlots        Int                         @default(7)
  irSlots           Int                         @default(2)
  /// When set, position mode and starter counts cannot be changed (prevents post-draft breakage). Cleared only by admin or explicit unlock.
  settingsLockedAt  DateTime?
  createdAt         DateTime                    @default(now())
  updatedAt         DateTime                    @updatedAt
  bestBallSnapshots IdpBestBallLineupSnapshot[]
  league            League                      @relation(fields: [leagueId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  auditLogs         IdpSettingsAuditLog[]

  @@map("idp_league_configs")
}

/// Dynasty core league config (shared base for standard Dynasty, Devy, C2C). PROMPT 2/5 + PROMPT 3/5 taxi.
model DynastyLeagueConfig {
  id                        String                      @id @default(uuid())
  leagueId                  String                      @unique @db.VarChar(64)
  /// 13 or 14 weeks default; avoid Week 18 title
  regularSeasonWeeks        Int                         @default(14)
  /// reverse_standings | max_pf | commissioner
  rookiePickOrderMethod     String                      @default("max_pf") @db.VarChar(32)
  /// Non-playoff teams ordered by reverse Max PF (anti-tank)
  useMaxPfForNonPlayoff     Boolean                     @default(true)
  rookieDraftRounds         Int                         @default(4)
  /// linear | snake
  rookieDraftType           String                      @default("linear") @db.VarChar(16)
  divisionsEnabled          Boolean                     @default(false)
  /// Week number before fantasy playoffs; null = no deadline
  tradeDeadlineWeek         Int?
  /// FAAB recommended; stored in waiver settings
  waiverTypeRecommended     String                      @default("faab") @db.VarChar(24)
  /// Future picks tradable years out (2 or 3)
  futurePicksYearsOut       Int                         @default(3)
  createdAt                 DateTime                    @default(now())
  updatedAt                 DateTime                    @updatedAt
  /// PROMPT 3: Taxi squad slot count (core dynasty default 4; Devy/C2C override via their config).
  taxiSlots                 Int                         @default(4)
  /// 1 = rookies only, 2 = rookies + 2nd year, 3 = rookies + 2nd + 3rd year
  taxiEligibilityYears      Int                         @default(1)
  /// once_promoted_no_return | free_move | commissioner_custom
  taxiLockBehavior          String                      @default("once_promoted_no_return") @db.VarChar(32)
  taxiInSeasonMoves         Boolean                     @default(true)
  taxiPostseasonMoves       Boolean                     @default(false)
  /// Default false: taxi players do not score; specialty modes (e.g. best ball) may override per league.
  taxiScoringOn             Boolean                     @default(false)
  /// Week number after which no taxi moves; null = no deadline
  taxiDeadlineWeek          Int?
  /// Week number after which no promotions from taxi; null = no deadline
  taxiPromotionDeadlineWeek Int?
  draftOrderAuditLogs       DynastyDraftOrderAuditLog[]
  league                    League                      @relation(fields: [leagueId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@map("dynasty_league_configs")
}

  supportsDevyDraft             Boolean  @default(true)

  supportsTaxi                  Boolean  @default(true)
  supportsFuturePicks           Boolean  @default(true)
  supportsTradeableDevyPicks    Boolean  @default(true)
  supportsTradeableRookiePicks  Boolean  @default(true)
  /// Commissioner-controlled roster/draft settings.
  devySlotCount                 Int      @default(6)
  taxiSize                      Int      @default(6)
  rookieDraftRounds             Int      @default(4)
  devyDraftRounds               Int      @default(4)

  maxYearlyDevyPromotions       Int?
  earlyDeclareBehavior          String   @default("allow") @db.VarChar(24)
  rookiePickOrderMethod         String   @default("reverse_standings") @db.VarChar(32)
  devyPickOrderMethod           String   @default("reverse_standings") @db.VarChar(32)
  devyPickTradeRules            String   @default("allowed") @db.VarChar(24)
  rookiePickTradeRules          String   @default("allowed") @db.VarChar(24)
  /// NFL-only: exclude K/DST from devy pool (default false = include eligible only; devy pool is QB/RB/WR/TE).
  nflDevyExcludeKDST            Boolean  @default(false)
  createdAt                     DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt                     DateTime @updatedAt
  /// PROMPT 3: When to apply promotion: immediate_after_pro_draft | rollover | manager_choice_before_rookie_draft
  promotionTiming               String   @default("manager_choice_before_rookie_draft") @db.VarChar(48)
  /// Allow devy players (NCAA, not rostered) on waivers/FA when enabled; FAAB or priority per league.

  /// If enabled, rights expire after configured period when not promoted (commissioner tool to clean).
  rightsExpirationEnabled       Boolean  @default(false)
  /// PROMPT 4: When best ball is ON, if true then taxi-eligible pro rookies can contribute to best ball lineup; otherwise taxi players do not score.
  taxiProRookiesScoreInBestBall Boolean  @default(false)
  /// PROMPT 4: Superflex slot in best ball (NFL). When true, lineup has SUPER_FLEX in addition to FLEX.
  bestBallSuperflex             Boolean  @default(false)
  /// PROMPT 3: When player returns to school: restore_rights | hold_rights | commissioner
  returnToSchoolHandling        String   @default("restore_rights") @db.VarChar(32)
  devyIRSlots                   Int      @default(0)
  devyScoringEnabled            Boolean  @default(false)
  collegeSports                 Json?

  @@map("devy_league_configs")

/// PROMPT 3: Per-roster devy rights and lifecycle state. One row per (league, roster, devyPlayer) when a manager holds devy rights.
model DevyRights {
  id                  String    @id @default(uuid())
  leagueId            String    @db.VarChar(64)
  rosterId            String    @db.VarChar(64)
  devyPlayerId        String    @db.VarChar(64)
  /// Lifecycle: NCAA_DEVY_ACTIVE | NCAA_DEVY_TAXI | NCAA_DEVY_LOCKED | DECLARED | DRAFTED_RIGHTS_HELD | PROMOTION_ELIGIBLE | PROMOTED_TO_PRO | RETURNED_TO_SCHOOL | RIGHTS_EXPIRED | ORPHANED_RIGHTS
  state               String    @db.VarChar(32)
  seasonYear          Int?
  /// After promotion, pro player id (SportsPlayer or platform) when mapped
  promotedProPlayerId String?   @db.VarChar(64)
  promotedAt          DateTime?
  /// When manager chose promotion (if timing = manager_choice_before_rookie_draft)
  managerPromotedAt   DateTime?
  /// If returned to school, restored to NCAA devy state
  returnedToSchoolAt  DateTime?
  /// Source confidence for declare/draft mapping (0-100)
  sourceConfidence    Int       @default(0)
  createdAt           DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt           DateTime  @updatedAt
  slotCategory        String    @default("DEVY") @db.VarChar(16)
  /// C2C-only lineup role for this rights row. 'STARTER' routes the player
  /// to the college-starters bucket in league-home.ts; null = college bench.
  /// Written by lib/workers/devy-data-worker.ts on campus lineup sync.
  c2cLineupRole       String?   @db.VarChar(16)
  league              League    @relation(fields: [leagueId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  roster              Roster    @relation(fields: [rosterId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([leagueId, rosterId, devyPlayerId])
  @@index([leagueId])
  @@index([rosterId])
  @@index([devyPlayerId])
  @@index([state])
  @@index([leagueId, state])
  @@index([leagueId, rosterId, slotCategory])
  @@map("devy_rights")
}

  createdAt                         DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt                         DateTime @updatedAt

/// Live draft session for a league. One active session per league at a time.
model DraftSession {
  id                         String                        @id @default(uuid())
  leagueId                   String                        @unique
  status                     String                        @default("pre_draft")
  draftType                  String                        @default("snake")
  rounds                     Int                           @default(15)
  teamCount                  Int                           @default(12)
  thirdRoundReversal         Boolean                       @default(false)
  timerSeconds               Int?
  /// When status=in_progress, server time when current pick expires (UTC).
  timerEndAt                 DateTime?
  /// While inside overnight pause window: frozen per-pick seconds remaining (timerEndAt cleared until window ends).
  overnightFrozenPickSeconds Int?
  /// When status=paused, remaining seconds for current pick.
  pausedRemainingSeconds     Int?
  /// Draft order: JSON array of { slot: number, rosterId: string, displayName: string }
  slotOrder                  Json                          @default("[]")
  version                    Int                           @default(0)
  /// Auction: default budget per team (e.g. 200).
  auctionBudgetPerTeam       Int?
  /// Auction: optional per-roster remaining budget { [rosterId]: number }. Initialized from auctionBudgetPerTeam on start.
  auctionBudgets             Json?
  /// Auction: current nomination/bid state { nominationOrderIndex, currentNomination?, currentBid?, currentBidderRosterId?, bidTimerEndAt?, minNextBid? }
  auctionState               Json?
  /// Keeper: config { maxKeepers, deadline?: ISO string, maxKeepersPerPosition?: Record<position, number> }
  keeperConfig               Json?
  /// Keeper: selections [{ rosterId, roundCost, playerName, position, team, playerId }] (roundCost = which round pick is spent)
  keeperSelections           Json?
  /// Devy: { enabled: boolean, devyRounds: number[] } (1-based round numbers that are devy-only; e.g. [14, 15])
  devyConfig                 Json?
  /// C2C: { enabled: boolean, collegeRounds: number[] } (1-based rounds that are college-only; rest are pro-only)
  c2cConfig                  Json?
  /// Draft pick trades: JSON array of { round, originalRosterId, previousOwnerName, newRosterId, newOwnerName } for ownership resolution
  tradedPicks                Json?                         @default("[]")
  createdAt                  DateTime                      @default(now())
  updatedAt                  DateTime                      @updatedAt
  /// Sleeper `draft_id` when syncing live drafts from Sleeper (optional).
  sleeperDraftId             String?                       @unique
  /// `live` = Sleeper-synced; `mock` = AllFantasy mock (may also use MockDraftRoom).
  sessionKind                String                        @default("live")
  /// Next overall pick number (1-based).
  nextOverallPick            Int                           @default(1)
  /// Display round (1-based).
  currentRoundNum            Int                           @default(1)
  /// Commissioner user id when `status=paused` (optional audit).
  pausedByUserId             String?
  /// First transition to `in_progress` (canonical draft start time).
  startedAt                  DateTime?
  /// When `status=completed`.
  completedAt                DateTime?
  /// rookie | startup | supplemental | dispersal | standard Ã¢â‚¬â€ informational for specialty pools.
  draftModeLabel             String?                       @db.VarChar(32)
  /// Dispersal / specialty: { eligibleRosterIds?: string[], protectedPlayerIds?: string[], allowedAssetTypes?: string[] }
  dispersalPoolConfig        Json?
  /// Chimmy AI auto-pick when timer expires (mirrors LeagueSettings.aiAutoPick at draft start).
  aiAutoPick                 Boolean                       @default(false)
  alphabeticalSort           Boolean                       @default(false)
  /// Rules-based auto-pick fallback when timer expires.
  cpuAutoPick                Boolean                       @default(true)
  /// all | rookies_only | veterans_only
  playerPool                 String                        @default("all")
  sportType                  String?                       @db.VarChar(16)
  /// Commissioner AI draft managers: assignments (max 4 orphan rosters), trade rules, optional throttle metadata.
  commissionerAiManagers     Json?
  /// Slice 1: on-the-clock pick trade behavior Ã¢â‚¬â€ "inherit_remaining" (Sleeper-parity) or "reset_timer".
  onClockTradeTimerBehavior  String                        @default("inherit_remaining") @db.VarChar(32)
  /// Slice 1: allow in-draft trading of already-drafted players (separate from pickTradeEnabled which gates pick trades).
  inDraftPlayerTradesEnabled Boolean                       @default(true)
  /// Slice 1: gate the per-user CSV custom rankings feature for this draft (queue/AI/autopick fallback).
  customRankingsEnabled      Boolean                       @default(true)
  aiRecommendationLogs       AiRecommendationLog[]
  draftChatMessages          DraftChatMessage[]
  tradeProposals             DraftPickTradeProposal[]
  draftIntroViews            DraftIntroView[]
  picks                      DraftPick[]
  queueEntries               DraftQueueEntry[]
  queues                     DraftQueue[]
  draftPickAuditLogs         DraftPickAuditLog[]
  draftRecaps                DraftRecap[]
  league                     League                        @relation(fields: [leagueId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  warRoomSnapshots           WarRoomSnapshot[]
  liveAutopickPreferences    LiveDraftAutopickPreference[]

  @@index([leagueId])
  @@index([status])
  @@index([leagueId, sportType])
  @@index([sportType, status])
  @@map("draft_sessions")
}

/// T2: immutable deterministic value snapshot captured at proposal time. Never updated after
/// creation â€” preserves the original grade/values for historical comparison even if live values
/// change later. `payload` holds the full TradeValueSnapshot (sides, per-asset values, sources).
model RedraftTradeValueSnapshot {
  id              String               @id @default(cuid())

  fairnessScore   Int
  confidenceScore Int
  valueDifference Int
  createdAt       DateTime             @default(now())
  proposal        RedraftTradeProposal @relation(fields: [proposalId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@map("redraft_trade_value_snapshots")
}

/// T3: append-only normalized trade-market event ledger. No FK to proposals â€” the ledger must
/// survive even if a proposal row is later removed. Internal user ids only (no PII). This table is
/// written-to only; nothing in this PR reads it back to change player values.
model RedraftTradeMarketEvent {
  id              String   @id @default(cuid())
  leagueId        String
  seasonId        String
  tradeProposalId String
  eventType       String
  actorUserId     String?
  idempotencyKey  String   @unique
  statusAtEvent   String?
  sport           String?
  grade           String?
  fairnessScore   Int?
  confidenceScore Int?
  payload         Json     @default("{}")
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([leagueId, createdAt])
  @@index([tradeProposalId])
  @@index([eventType])
  @@map("redraft_trade_market_events")
}

/// T9: official AllFantasy-owned market value, computed from internal trade signals and stored
/// SEPARATELY. Never overwrites provider/ADP/projection/snapshot data. Conservative + reversible
/// (see AllFantasyMarketValueAudit). Display-only; does not change trade grading by default.
model AllFantasyMarketPlayerValue {
  id                  String   @id @default(cuid())
  sport               String
  leagueConcept       String
  scoringFormat       String?
  playerId            String
  playerName          String?
  position            String?
  team                String?
  baseValue           Int
  marketValue         Int
  adjustmentPercent   Float
  adjustmentPoints    Int
  confidence          Int
  sampleSize          Int
  acceptedTradeCount  Int      @default(0)
  rejectedSignalCount Int      @default(0)
  vetoedSignalCount   Int      @default(0)
  blockSignalCount    Int      @default(0)
  interestSignalCount Int      @default(0)
  recentSignalCount   Int      @default(0)
  direction           String
  published           Boolean  @default(false)
  sourceVersion       String
  calculationVersion  String
  reasons             Json     @default("[]")
  generatedAt         DateTime
  createdAt           DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt           DateTime @updatedAt

  @@unique([sport, leagueConcept, playerId])
  @@index([sport, leagueConcept, position])
  @@index([generatedAt])
  @@index([confidence])
  @@index([sampleSize])
  @@map("allfantasy_market_player_values")
}

/// D.5-test Ã¢â‚¬â€ AllFantasy AI ADP snapshot. One row per (player, context, draftMode).
/// `draftMode` separates `real` (production AllFantasy drafts), `mock` (mock-draft tool),
/// and `test` (seeded harness drafts that must never leak into production AI ADP).
/// `contextHash` collapses the (sport, leagueType, draftType, scoringFormat, rosterFormat,
/// teamCount, season) tuple into a single string used as the natural key.
model AllFantasyAdpSnapshot {
  id                 String   @id @default(uuid())
  /// Stable player identity Ã¢â‚¬â€ `${normalizedName}|${position}` so the resolver can join
  /// pool rows without a real provider id (pool rows often use synthetic ids).
  playerKey          String
  playerName         String
  sport              String   @db.VarChar(16)
  leagueType         String   @db.VarChar(32)
  draftType          String   @db.VarChar(32)
  scoringFormat      String   @db.VarChar(32)
  rosterFormat       String   @db.VarChar(32)
  teamCount          Int
  season             String   @db.VarChar(16)
  /// `real` | `mock` | `test`. The recompute script writes one row per draftMode it sees.
  draftMode          String   @db.VarChar(16)
  sampleSize         Int
  averageOverallPick Float
  averageRound       Float
  averagePickInRound Float
  minOverallPick     Int
  maxOverallPick     Int
  /// Population standard deviation of overall picks. Null when sampleSize<2.
  standardDeviation  Float?
  /// ÃŽâ€ vs. the snapshot from 7 days ago for the same (player, context, draftMode); null when no prior snapshot exists.
  sevenDayTrend      Float?
  thirtyDayTrend     Float?
  /// Pre-hashed context for unique constraint + fast lookup from the pool resolver.
  contextHash        String   @db.VarChar(96)
  lastUpdatedAt      DateTime @default(now()) @updatedAt
  createdAt          DateTime @default(now())

  @@unique([playerKey, contextHash, draftMode])
  @@index([sport, season, draftMode])
  @@index([contextHash, draftMode])
  @@index([playerKey])
  @@map("allfantasy_adp_snapshots")
}

/// Phase 1 â€” centralized automation orchestration (jobs, runs, audit, notification outbox).
/// Future: waiver batches (`waivers.processLeague`), draft ticks (`draft.tick`), scoring sync (`scoring.sync`),
/// trade automation (`trades.process`), and specialty league concepts (`leagueConcept.*`) enqueue work here.
/// `leagueId` / `userId` are scalar FK-style ids only (no Prisma relations) to avoid coupling & migration risk on `League` / `AppUser`.
model AutomationJob {
  id             String          @id @default(uuid())
  leagueId       String?
  userId         String?
  jobType        String
  status         String          @default("pending")
  priority       Int             @default(5)
  idempotencyKey String          @unique
  scheduledFor   DateTime?
  startedAt      DateTime?
  finishedAt     DateTime?
  attemptCount   Int             @default(0)
  maxAttempts    Int             @default(3)
  lastError      String?
  metadata       Json?
  createdAt      DateTime        @default(now())
  updatedAt      DateTime        @updatedAt
  runs           AutomationRun[]

  @@index([jobType])
  @@index([status])
  @@index([leagueId])
  @@index([scheduledFor])
  @@index([createdAt])
  @@map("automation_jobs")
}

/// One execution attempt / observability row for automation (pairs with `AutomationJob` when `jobId` is set).
model AutomationRun {
  id           String         @id @default(uuid())
  jobId        String?
  leagueId     String?
  jobType      String
  status       String
  startedAt    DateTime       @default(now())
  finishedAt   DateTime?
  durationMs   Int?
  errorMessage String?
  errorStack   String?
  metadata     Json?
  createdAt    DateTime       @default(now())
  job          AutomationJob? @relation(fields: [jobId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)

  @@index([jobType])
  @@index([status])
  @@index([leagueId])
  @@index([createdAt])
  @@map("automation_runs")
}

  jobId      String?
  action     String
  entityType String?

  @@index([userId])
  @@index([action])
  @@index([createdAt])
  @@map("automation_audit_logs")
}

/// Append-only log of Resend email delivery events (bounced, complained, failed, delivery_delayed).
/// Payload is sanitized â€” recipient addresses are removed before storage.
/// svixId (the Svix unique message ID header) is the idempotency key; duplicate webhook
/// deliveries from Resend are safely ignored via the unique constraint.
model ResendEmailEvent {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  /// Svix-id header value â€” unique per webhook delivery, used for idempotency
  svixId    String   @unique @db.VarChar(128)
  /// Resend email_id (data.email_id in the webhook payload)
  messageId String   @db.VarChar(128)
  /// Event type: email.bounced | email.complained | email.failed | email.delivery_delayed | etc.
  eventType String   @db.VarChar(64)
  /// Sanitized event payload (to/from fields removed; diagnostic data retained)
  payload   Json?
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([messageId])
  @@index([eventType])
  @@index([createdAt])
  @@map("resend_email_events")
}

/// Phase 3A.2 Batch 2 â€” Chimmy context engine telemetry.
/// Append-only fire-and-forget log of every Chimmy intelligence/context run.
/// No FK on userId/leagueId so cleanup is fully decoupled from the engine
/// and writes never cascade-block. PII-safe: stores ids only.
model ChimmyContextRun {
  id                     String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId                 String   @db.VarChar(64)
  leagueId               String?  @db.VarChar(64)
  /// Origin of this run: "chat" | "intelligence_api" | "context_api".
  surface                String   @db.VarChar(32)
  /// ChimmyIntent classification (chat surface only).
  intent                 String?  @db.VarChar(48)
  /// Canary decision reason: "global" | "allowlist" | "rollout" | "off".
  canaryReason           String?  @db.VarChar(16)
  /// 0-99 deterministic rollout bucket assigned to this user.
  rolloutBucket          Int?
  /// Total engine duration including providers (ms).
  durationMs             Int
  /// Composed prompt block character count (chat surface only).
  approxPromptChars      Int?
  /// IntelligenceContextSlice.urgencyLevel snapshot.
  urgencyLevel           String?  @db.VarChar(16)
  /// IntelligenceContextSlice.recommendationSeverity snapshot.
  recommendationSeverity String?  @db.VarChar(16)
  /// strategicRiskScores.composite (0-100).
  riskComposite          Int?
  /// topRisks[0].dimension if present.
  topRisk                String?  @db.VarChar(16)
  /// Count of providers that returned cached results.
  cacheHitCount          Int      @default(0)
  /// Count of providers that returned ok=false.
  providerFailureCount   Int      @default(0)
  /// Compact provider telemetry: [{name, ok, cached, durationMs}].
  providerMeta           Json?
  /// Compact section telemetry: [{id, rendered, dropped, truncated}].
  sectionMeta            Json?
  /// Sanitized short error message when the run partially failed.
  errorMessage           String?  @db.VarChar(256)
  createdAt              DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([userId, createdAt])
  @@index([leagueId, createdAt])
  @@index([surface, createdAt])
  @@index([urgencyLevel, createdAt])
  @@index([createdAt])
  @@map("chimmy_context_runs")
}

model ChimmyIntelligenceFeedback {

  reason      String?  @db.VarChar(24)
  surface     String   @default("rail") @db.VarChar(32)
  cohortLabel String?  @db.VarChar(24)
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([userId, createdAt])
  @@index([leagueId, createdAt])
  @@index([eventType, cardId, createdAt])
  @@index([createdAt])
  @@map("chimmy_intelligence_feedback")
}

/// Phase 6C â€” Resume snapshot persistence.
///
/// Denormalised, cache-friendly row that powers public profiles, AF
/// rankings, league applications, matchmaking and commissioner review.
///
/// Composition rules:
///   - One latest snapshot per (userId). Historical snapshots are stored in
///     `ResumeSnapshotHistory` (immutable, append-only) when the composer
///     decides a recompute crossed a meaningful threshold.
///   - `payload` holds the fully composed `FantasyResume` for the OWNER
///     view. Public consumers MUST go through the visibility serializer.
///   - All score/percentile fields are denormalized for leaderboard / index
///     scans so the JSON blob is never required for ranking pages.
model ResumeSnapshot {
  id                  String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId              String   @unique @db.VarChar(64)
  computedAt          DateTime @default(now())
  /// Source data freshness (max of underlying inputs). Used to decide
  /// whether a recompute is required.
  sourceFreshAt       DateTime?
  /// Monotonic composer version. Bumped when scoring math changes so old
  /// rows can be invalidated en masse.
  composerVersion     Int      @default(1)

  /// Denormalised hot fields for leaderboards + filters.
  overallRating       Int?
  topSport            String?  @db.VarChar(16)
  championships       Int      @default(0)
  seasons             Int      @default(0)
  percentile          Decimal? @db.Decimal(6, 4)
  percentileBand      String?  @db.VarChar(16)
  archetypeLabel      String?  @db.VarChar(64)
  archetypeConfidence Decimal? @db.Decimal(6, 4)

  /// Explainability summary persisted for fast debug surfaces.
  strongestCategory   String?  @db.VarChar(96)
  weakestCategory     String?  @db.VarChar(96)
  ratingDeltaReason   String?  @db.VarChar(160)

  /// Credibility roll-up.
  credibilityScore    Decimal  @default(0.5) @db.Decimal(6, 4)
  credibilityFlags    String[] @default([])
  verifiedTrophyCount Int      @default(0)

  /// Full composed FantasyResume (owner-view). JSON for forward-compat.
  payload             Json

  createdAt           DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt           DateTime @default(now()) @updatedAt

  history             ResumeSnapshotHistory[]
  credibilityRecord   ResumeCredibility?
  verificationFlags   ResumeVerificationFlag[]
  archetype           ResumeArchetypeRecord?
  visibilitySettings  ResumeVisibilitySettings? @relation("ResumeSnapshotVisibility")

  /// Leaderboard / lookup indexes.
  @@index([overallRating])
  @@index([topSport, overallRating])
  @@index([percentileBand, overallRating])
  @@index([archetypeLabel])
  @@index([computedAt])
  @@map("resume_snapshots")
}

/// Append-only history of past resume snapshots. Future-ready; the
/// composer decides when to emit a row (e.g. on rating-delta threshold or
/// championship change).
model ResumeSnapshotHistory {
  id              String   @id @default(cuid())
  snapshotId      String
  userId          String   @db.VarChar(64)
  computedAt      DateTime @default(now())
  composerVersion Int      @default(1)
  overallRating   Int?
  championships   Int      @default(0)
  percentile      Decimal? @db.Decimal(6, 4)
  payload         Json
  reason          String?  @db.VarChar(48)

  snapshot ResumeSnapshot @relation(fields: [snapshotId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId, computedAt])
  @@index([snapshotId, computedAt])
  @@map("resume_snapshot_history")
}

/// Per-user credibility persistence. Mirrors `CredibilitySignal` but kept
/// in its own row so verification jobs can update independently of the
/// main snapshot composer.
model ResumeCredibility {
  id              String   @id @default(cuid())
  snapshotId      String   @unique
  userId          String   @unique @db.VarChar(64)
  confidence      Decimal  @default(0.5) @db.Decimal(6, 4)
  providerWeights Json     @default("{}")
  flags           String[] @default([])
  updatedAt       DateTime @default(now()) @updatedAt

  snapshot ResumeSnapshot @relation(fields: [snapshotId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([confidence])
  @@map("resume_credibility")
}

/// Persisted per-trophy verification flag. Allows commissioner review and
/// dispute workflows to track individual rows without rewriting the whole
/// resume payload.
model ResumeVerificationFlag {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  snapshotId  String
  userId      String   @db.VarChar(64)
  trophyId    String   @db.VarChar(96)
  flag        String   @db.VarChar(32)
  status      String   @db.VarChar(24)
  evidence    Json?
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  resolvedAt  DateTime?

  snapshot ResumeSnapshot @relation(fields: [snapshotId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([snapshotId, trophyId, flag], name: "uniq_resume_flag")
  @@index([userId, status])
  @@index([flag, status])
  @@map("resume_verification_flags")
}

/// Per-user resume visibility + anonymity preferences. Owner-controlled.
/// Single row per user.
model ResumeVisibilitySettings {
  id                  String   @id @default(cuid())
  snapshotId          String?  @unique
  userId              String   @unique @db.VarChar(64)
  /// JSON-encoded `ResumeVisibilityMap`. Defaults applied in the
  /// visibility helper; absent keys fall back to `DEFAULT_VISIBILITY`.
  visibility          Json     @default("{}")
  anonymityEnabled    Boolean  @default(false)
  hideUsername        Boolean  @default(false)
  updatedAt           DateTime @default(now()) @updatedAt

  snapshot ResumeSnapshot? @relation("ResumeSnapshotVisibility", fields: [snapshotId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)

  @@map("resume_visibility_settings")
}

/// Persisted archetype derivation result. Nullable label â€” AI fill-in
/// happens out of band.
model ResumeArchetypeRecord {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  snapshotId  String   @unique
  userId      String   @unique @db.VarChar(64)
  label       String?  @db.VarChar(64)
  confidence  Decimal? @db.Decimal(6, 4)
  source      String?  @db.VarChar(32)
  computedAt  DateTime @default(now())

  snapshot ResumeSnapshot @relation(fields: [snapshotId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([label])
  @@map("resume_archetypes")
}

/// Persistent cross-season future draft pick record. One row per (leagueId, season, round, originalRosterId).
/// currentOwnerId tracks ownership after trades; originalOwnerId is immutable for audit.
model FutureDraftPick {
  id               String                @id @default(cuid())
  leagueId         String                @db.VarChar(64)
  /// The draft year this pick belongs to (e.g. 2027 for a 2027 2nd-round pick).
  pickSeason       Int
  round            Int
  /// The roster this pick was originally assigned to (immutable â€” identity of the "home" team's pick).
  originalRosterId String                @db.VarChar(64)
  /// The roster currently holding this pick (changes on trade).
  currentOwnerId   String                @db.VarChar(64)
  status           FutureDraftPickStatus @default(active)
  traded           Boolean               @default(false)
  /// FK to the AfLeagueTrade that last transferred this pick (nullable if never traded).
  sourceTradeId    String?               @db.VarChar(64)
  tradedAt         DateTime?
  usedInDraftSessionId String?           @db.VarChar(64)
  usedAt           DateTime?
  forfeitedAt      DateTime?
  forfeitReason    String?               @db.VarChar(128)
  createdAt        DateTime              @default(now())
  updatedAt        DateTime              @updatedAt

  league League @relation(fields: [leagueId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([leagueId, pickSeason, round, originalRosterId])
  @@index([leagueId, pickSeason])
  @@index([currentOwnerId, pickSeason])
  @@index([leagueId, status])
  @@map("future_draft_picks")
}

/// Immutable audit record of what each roster carried over between seasons.

  toSeason        Int

  /// Snapshot of playerData at time of carryover (immutable audit).
  playerDataSnapshot Json?
  /// Number of keepers carried.
  keeperCount     Int      @default(0)
  /// Number of taxi slots carried.
  taxiCount       Int      @default(0)
  /// Number of devy rights carried.
  devyRightsCount Int      @default(0)
  appliedAt       DateTime @default(now())
  appliedBy       String   @db.VarChar(64)

  league League @relation(fields: [leagueId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([leagueId, rosterId, fromSeason, toSeason])
  @@index([leagueId, toSeason])
  @@index([rosterId, toSeason])
  @@map("roster_carryovers")
}

/// Append-only audit log for every AI interaction across all sports.
/// One row per LLM call (or deterministic bypass). Never mutate rows.
/// Used for billing reconciliation, debugging, compliance, and cost monitoring.
model AiInteractionLog {
  id               String   @id @default(cuid())
  /// Null for unauthenticated / guest requests.
  userId           String?  @db.VarChar(64)
  /// SportKey: "world_cup" | "nba" | "nfl" | etc.
  sport            String   @db.VarChar(32)
  /// FeatureKey: "pool_chat" | "commissioner_brain" | etc.
  feature          String   @db.VarChar(64)
  /// The Next.js API route path that triggered this call.
  route            String?  @db.VarChar(128)
  /// User's plan at time of call: "free" | "pro" | "commissioner" | "supreme" | "war_room".
  plan             String?  @db.VarChar(32)
  /// AI provider that generated the response: "openai" | "anthropic" | "deterministic" | "unavailable".
  providerSource   String?  @db.VarChar(32)
  /// DataFreshnessTier: "live" | "cached" | "schedule_only" | "pool_only" | "none".
  freshnessTier    String?  @db.VarChar(32)
  /// Coarse intent category from grounding (e.g. "leaderboard", "picks", "live_score").
  promptIntent     String?  @db.VarChar(64)
  /// What data was NOT available for this call.
  missingData      String[]
  /// What Chimmy was authorized to claim.
  allowedClaims    String[]
  /// "clean" | "warned" | "blocked" | "deterministic".
  validatorResult  String?  @db.VarChar(32)
  /// Which validation rule triggered a block, if any.
  blockedReason    String?  @db.VarChar(64)
  /// Model identifier returned by the provider (e.g. "gpt-4o-mini", "claude-3-haiku").
  modelUsed        String?  @db.VarChar(64)
  /// Approximate token cost as reported by the provider.
  tokenCost        Int?
  /// True when the response was served from deterministic logic with no LLM call.
  wasDeterministic   Boolean  @default(false)
  /// Billing intent reason from resolveBillingDecision():
  /// "deterministic" | "cache_hit" | "llm_required" | "premium_plan_included" | "validator_blocked" | "provider_missing" | "error"
  billingReason      String?  @db.VarChar(32)
  /// Policy decision: was this call supposed to charge a token?
  shouldChargeToken  Boolean  @default(false)
  /// Outcome: was a token actually deducted via TokenSpendService?
  tokenCharged       Boolean  @default(false)
  /// Settlement status: "not_applicable" | "plan_included" | "charged" | "failed"
  tokenChargeStatus  String?  @db.VarChar(32)
  createdAt          DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([userId, createdAt])
  @@index([sport, feature, createdAt])
  @@index([validatorResult])
  @@index([providerSource, createdAt])
  @@index([shouldChargeToken, createdAt])
  @@index([tokenCharged, createdAt])
  @@index([createdAt])
  @@map("ai_interaction_logs")
}

/// Thumbs-up / thumbs-down feedback on AI answers from any feature.
/// Keyed by (userId, feature, resultKey) â€” one row per userÃ—answer.
/// No raw prompt text is stored â€” only a hash for analytics aggregation.
model AiFeedback {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  /// AllFantasy user id â€” same as AppUser.id.
  userId      String   @db.VarChar(64)
  /// Which AI feature generated the answer: "wc_chimmy" | "wc_explain_bracket" | etc.
  feature     String   @db.VarChar(64)
  /// Optional: AiResult.resultKey this feedback is attached to.
  resultKey   String?  @db.VarChar(255)
  /// "helpful" or "not_helpful"
  rating      String   @db.VarChar(32)
  /// SHA-256 hash (first 16 chars) of the normalized prompt â€” for analytics, never raw text.
  promptHash  String?  @db.VarChar(32)
  /// Sport context at the time of the answer.
  sport       String?  @db.VarChar(32)
  /// Optional user-selected reason for "not_helpful" ratings.
  /// e.g. "too_basic" | "not_actionable" | "wrong_data" | "great_insight"
  reason      String?  @db.VarChar(32)
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())

  @@unique([userId, feature, resultKey])
  @@index([feature, rating, createdAt])
  @@index([feature, reason, createdAt])
  @@index([userId, createdAt])
  @@index([resultKey])
  @@map("ai_feedback")
}
